set.pl: Kuehn farmyard, NW part of the SW quarter of sec. 22, Sigel Township, Brown County, by the sec. 21/22 road (1905 atlas quarter; 1939 aerial farmyard)
set.t: The 1906 jar under the plum trees was most likely the buried papers, and the will contest was settled in May 1906, so the odds of more money are modest. Farmstead garden and old plum rows around the 1939 farmyard. Occupied farm: ask permission first.
